title: Social composition grid
slide_intent: Demonstrate variation within a repeatable frame because a stream of messages must stay recognizable without looking identical.
strategic_value: A mix of portraits, illustration and short phrases can let Duolingo present different people and occasions in one social identity.
demonstration: Twelve square social examples form three rows of four, mixing portraits, characters, Duo, multilingual words and bright backgrounds.
practical_value: Compare which repeated elements are sufficient to connect a varied social series.

content_islands.name: Top row
content_islands.spec: Show four square tiles combining character, portrait, download milestone and diversity message.

content_islands.name: Middle row
content_islands.spec: Arrange text, a character reference, a portrait and Duo in a helmet as distinct compositions.

content_islands.name: Bottom row
content_islands.spec: Finish with portrait, family-language text, Duo and a rainbow-colored pride image.

reference_purposes.Application: The grid demonstrates twelve social-format compositions.
reference_purposes.Expression: Shared type and short text connect otherwise varied photographs, illustrations and colors.
